open_points.subject: ArtifactPointer publication retry
open_points.text: “the request id of its publish, as Kernel or the owner interface gave it” conflicts with R0-88’s narrower “As a write of the agent, a publish carries a request id” and its session-specific retry conditions
open_points.question: Does an owner publication require a request id, and does retrying that id return the original pointer rather than create a new version; if so, what authorization condition replaces the agent-session grant check?
options: Owner publishes have the same replay identity, with retry allowed whenever the project still permits owner publication
Only agent publications are replayed by request id; an owner repeat is a new publication
Owner publications carry request ids but their retry behavior is separately defined
open_points.default_guess: Treat owner publications as request-idempotent and return the original pointer while the project is not archived.

open_points.subject: Import of legacy artifact types
open_points.text: “The first release declares one: `estimate` by PresuPro” conflicts with the import keeping projects “with their customers, objects, rooms and pointers (ids kept)” while the v1 sets are evidence of “`estimate` by PresuPro and Kernel's types”
open_points.question: What does the one-time import do when a selected project contains a pointer whose legacy type is not the first release’s declared `estimate` type?
options: Preserve the pointer as a read-only legacy undeclared type
Map the legacy type to a declared type under an explicit migration mapping
Omit the pointer from the import
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the whole import to preserve the invariant that every ArtifactPointer has a declared type.
